command:
set -eu
LOG=/tmp/c6-smoke.log
grep -q 'GatewayLink backend=uart1' "$LOG"
(grep -q 'persisted coordinator network restored' "$LOG" || grep -q 'network formed' "$LOG")
grep -q 'measurement local_i2c/' "$LOG"
grep -q 'link backend=uart1' "$LOG"
if grep -Eiq 'Guru Meditation|abort\(\)|panic|watchdog|ZIGBEE_DEVICE_LEAVE_RESET|APS.*security.*failed|security.*failed|dropped [0-9]+ gateway events|dropped [0-9]+ GatewayLink messages' "$LOG"; then
  echo 'fatal smoke-test pattern found'
  grep -Ein 'Guru Meditation|abort\(\)|panic|watchdog|ZIGBEE_DEVICE_LEAVE_RESET|APS.*security.*failed|security.*failed|dropped [0-9]+ gateway events|dropped [0-9]+ GatewayLink messages' "$LOG" || true
  exit 1
fi
echo 'C6 UART smoke PASS'
git status --short
